last.minutes: The broader market remains in a neutral regime, characterized by selective momentum amidst institutional ETF inflows and 'Uptober' sentiment. We choose to maintain our core spot allocations in BTC and SOL alongside a healthy cash buffer, effectively mitigating round-trip transaction costs and non-deductible tax drag. In the futures book, we let the winning 2x long on NEAR run to capture further upside driven by ecosystem recovery news and strong trend momentum. This balanced stance preserves capital while keeping upside exposure intact.

futures.why: Holding the profitable 2x NEAR long rides robust ecosystem momentum and quant trend strength without incurring re-entry costs.

spot.why: Holding our core BTC position captures ongoing institutional ETF inflows and market stability while minimizing turnover fees.
Maintaining SOL provides exposure to high liquidity and upside near local resistance without inducing unnecessary trade friction.

lessons.text: Holding core positions and maintaining cash during a neutral, range-bound regime protects capital from heavy transaction fees and non-deductible tax drag.
In a neutral regime, the combined drag of transaction fees and non-deductible taxes makes holding cash and core majors more effective than frequent altcoin rotation.
Allowing a winning futures trade with fundamental momentum to run while keeping spot book churn minimal is the most effective approach in a neutral market with high tax friction.
In a neutral and consolidating market, preserving capital by holding core majors and maintaining a substantial cash buffer is far more effective than chasing volatile altcoin momentum.
In a neutral and tax-heavy regime, holding core majors and a significant cash buffer while letting a fundamentally supported futures trade run is the most effective way to preserve capital.
Resisting the urge to over-allocate cash in a neutral regime avoids unnecessary churn and non-deductible tax drag while allowing profitable trend positions to compound.
